selected_evidence.summary: stat shows '1777 root:root /srv/drop' and ls -ld shows drwxrwxrwt after mkdir/chown/chmod

selected_evidence.requirement: Users cannot remove files owned by other users (sticky bit enforcement)
selected_evidence.summary: testuser1 created file_from_user1.txt; testuser2's rm attempt failed with 'Operation not permitted'; file still present afterward

selected_evidence.requirement: Directory remains usable: any user can create files, owners can delete their own files
selected_evidence.summary: testuser2 created file_from_user2.txt successfully; testuser1 deleted its own file_from_user1.txt successfully

selected_evidence.requirement: Node polled until exec available again after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Two connection-timeout failures, then connection-reset, then successful exec confirms outage and recovery of node1's exec path

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof that boot identity changed (actual restart, not just elapsed time)
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed from d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 to b356d23e-2f8b-4164-922b-c2075ef80dee, proving a real reboot occurred

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== BASELINE: boot id =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

echo "== Create /srv/drop =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/drop

echo "== Set ownership and permissions (sticky bit + world writable) =="
sudo -n chown root:root /srv/drop
sudo -n chmod 1777 /srv/drop

echo "== Verify permissions =="
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /srv/drop
ls -ld /srv/drop

echo "== Create test users if not exist =="
sudo -n id testuser1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo -n useradd -m testuser1
sudo -n id testuser2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo -n useradd -m testuser2

echo "== testuser1 creates a file =="
sudo -n -u testuser1 touch /srv/drop/file_from_user1.txt
sudo -n -u testuser1 sh -c 'echo hello > /srv/drop/file_from_user1.txt'
ls -l /srv/drop/file_from_user1.txt

echo "== testuser2 attempts to delete testuser1's file (should fail) =="
if sudo -n -u testuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/file_from_user1.txt 2>/tmp/rm_err.txt; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: delete succeeded"
else
  echo "EXPECTED: delete failed"
  cat /tmp/rm_err.txt
fi

echo "== Confirm file still exists =="
ls -l /srv/drop/file_from_user1.txt

echo "== testuser2 can create its own file =="
sudo -n -u testuser2 sh -c 'echo world > /srv/drop/file_from_user2.txt'
ls -l /srv/drop/file_from_user2.txt

echo "== testuser1 can delete its own file (should succeed) =="
sudo -n -u testuser1 rm -f /srv/drop/file_from_user1.txt
ls -l /srv/drop/ || true

echo "== Final directory listing and perms =="
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /srv/drop
ls -la /srv/drop
